captions.detailed: This is a palm-sized, handheld camcorder styled in a sleek matte black finish. It features a main rectangular body with rounded edges, an integrated cylindrical handgrip along one side, and a short front-facing camera lens barrel. On the opposite side, a thin rectangular flip-out monitor screen is attached via a visible hinge block, allowing it to rotate outward. Three small grey prismatic buttons are located on the body wall just below the screen compartment, acting as manual controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a handheld camcorder with a rounded main body, a side cylindrical handgrip, and a front lens barrel. Include a flip-out side monitor connected by a rotating vertical hinge, and add three small prismatic push buttons on the body wall beneath the monitor compartment.
captions.factory: The main camera body is built using a filleted box combined with a cylinder for the side handgrip. The lens barrel is constructed from concentric cylinders with a front lens face. The flip-out monitor is created from a thin rectangular box connected to a vertical cylindrical hinge block on the body side. Three small rectangular boxes are placed as buttons in a recessed slot on the body wall. Revolute and continuous joints are defined for the monitor swing and lens ring rotation, while prismatic joints are assigned to each of the three buttons.
